_note: SYNTHETIC process areas for the demo methanol value chain.

areas.name: Feed Gas
areas.description: Natural gas receiving, metering and feed conditioning.

areas.name: Pretreatment
areas.description: Hydro-desulphurisation, ZnO guard beds and feed saturation.

areas.name: Reforming / Syngas
areas.description: Steam methane reformer F-101, waste-heat boiler and syngas cooling.

areas.name: Syngas Compression
areas.description: Make-up syngas compressor C-101 (steam turbine driven).

areas.name: Methanol Synthesis Loop
areas.description: Synthesis reactor R-201, recycle compressor C-201, loop exchangers E-205.

areas.name: Distillation
areas.description: Topping and refining columns (T-301) producing grade-AA methanol.

areas.name: Storage & Loading
areas.description: Product tankage TK-401/402 and marine loading.
